name: proto-blocks/oit-video-preview
title: OIT Video Preview
description: Click-to-play video card. Large rounded thumbnail with a centered play button; click opens a fullscreen lightbox with the player. Accepts YouTube, Vimeo, or self-hosted MP4. Thumbnails are auto-fetched from YouTube/Vimeo; MP4 requires a custom thumbnail.

videoFile.label: Video file (MP4, from Media Library)
videoFile.help: For the 'MP4 (self-hosted)' source. Pick an uploaded video from the media library. Overrides the MP4 URL field below.

videoUrl.label: Video URL or ID
videoUrl.help: YouTube/Vimeo: paste the full URL or just the video ID. MP4: paste the direct file URL (.mp4).
